nodes.label: TRINITY Coordinator
nodes.rationale: Lightweight coordinator (0.6B SLM + 10K parameters) optimized with evolutionary strategy to orchestrate multiple LLMs through multi-turn tri-role coordination

nodes.label: Hidden State Representations
nodes.rationale: Penultimate token hidden states from SLM provide rich contextual signals sufficient for lightweight head to coordinate diverse LLMs effectively

nodes.label: Tri-Role Coordination
nodes.rationale: Three distinct roles (Thinker, Worker, Verifier) enable coordinator to offload complex skill acquisition while maintaining lightweight parametrization

nodes.label: Separable CMA-ES Optimization
nodes.rationale: Derivative-free evolutionary strategy superior to RL under high dimensionality, weak parameter correlations, and tight budget constraints due to block-ε-separability

nodes.label: Singular Value Fine-tuning
nodes.rationale: Efficient parametrization learning only singular value scales while keeping orthogonal matrices fixed, enabling representational benefits with minimal parameters

nodes.label: Block-ε-Separability
nodes.rationale: Property of optimization landscape where most informative signal is concentrated within blocks with negligible inter-block interference

nodes.label: Representation State h(s)
nodes.rationale: Hidden state vector from SLM encoding contextual information about interaction state

nodes.label: Lightweight Coordination Head
nodes.rationale: Linear layer with ~10K parameters that maps hidden states to logits over agent-role pairs

nodes.label: TRINITY: Multi-Agent LLM Coordination Framework
nodes.author: Jinglue Xu, Qi Sun, Stefan Nielsen, Edoardo Cetin, Yujin Tang
nodes.rationale: Lightweight coordinator orchestrates diverse LLMs via tri-role protocol (direct, reasoning, verification) trained with sep-CMA-ES for state-of-the-art performance on LiveCodeBench, MATH500, MMLU, RLPR

nodes.label: sep-CMA-ES: Separable CMA-ES Algorithm
nodes.rationale: Evolutionary strategy optimized for block-separable objectives; outperforms REINFORCE and random search under binary rewards and strict budgets

nodes.label: Coordinator Head Architecture
nodes.rationale: Linear head most reliable; block-diagonal-10 with argmax maximizes independence among logits, revealing block-ε separability in problem objective

nodes.label: Hidden State Separability Analysis
nodes.rationale: SLM representations encode task semantics in nearly linearly separable manifold; task-type classification near-perfect (1.0 linear/RBF SVM); agent selection accuracy correlates with coordinator performance

nodes.label: Joint Dataset-Agent Subset Selection
nodes.rationale: Maximizes relative error reduction under complementarity constraints; exhaustive enumeration on top-5% performance frontier; prioritizes diversity in task and agent types

nodes.label: TRINITY uses sep-CMA-ES for coordinator training
TRINITY coordinator employs head architecture variants

hyperedges.label: Latent Representation Learning for Coordination
hyperedges.rationale: All three concepts leverage learned latent/hidden representations to enable effective coordination and decision-making in complex systems
